name: InsaneTimer_Register
comment: Entry of LECMODULE insane_timer: stores the service table of the module manager and the workspace size, registers the module and the TIMER insane interface

name: InsaneTimer_Init
comment: Allocates the timer workspace and starts the timer thread

name: InsaneTimer_StartThread
comment: First caller clears the 20 timer slots and creates the high priority thread InsaneTimer_ThreadProc

name: InsaneTimer_ThreadProc
comment: Timer thread: wakes every 16 ms of timeGetTime and runs InsaneTimer_Tick

name: InsaneTimer_Hold
comment: TIMER insane: suspends the periodic callbacks (counter)

name: InsaneTimer_AddTimer
comment: Finds a free slot (1..19) and fills in callback, period, flags and user data; returns the slot number or 0

name: InsaneTimer_Run
comment: Runs InsaneTimer_GetClock-driven steps until the clock has advanced by the given number of ticks

name: InsaneTimer_Tick
comment: Advances the timer clock by one step and runs the due callbacks

name: DsndDriver_Register
comment: Entry of LECMODULE insane_dsnd: registers the DirectSound sound driver (SNDDRIVER insane_dsnd)

name: DsndDriver_Init
comment: Gets the TIMER clock interface and allocates the mixer table

name: DsndDriver_Open
comment: Opens DirectSound and the mixer and starts the periodic DSound_FillStreamBuffer timer

name: DsndDriver_SetVolume
comment: Volume 0..127 through a logarithmic table to IDirectSoundBuffer::SetVolume on the stream buffer

name: DsndDriver_CreateStreamBuffer
comment: Creates the looping secondary stream buffer of N blocks of 0x1800 bytes (3..16), clears it and starts it

name: Dsnd_MemCopy
comment: memcpy for the Smush audio code; __fastcall with two unused register arguments (ECX, EDX)

name: Dsnd_MemFill
comment: memset with a byte value for the Smush audio code; __fastcall with two unused register arguments

name: Insane_MemCopy
comment: memcpy for the lecsmush code; __fastcall with two unused register arguments (ECX, EDX): copies the unaligned head first, then dwords

name: Mixer_InitTables
comment: Builds the 17x17 volume/pan table and the compander table and allocates the accumulator

name: Mixer_MixVoiceByFormat
comment: Callback handed to the driver: format code 0..5 (8/16 bit, mono/stereo, offset binary) to Mixer_MixVoice parameters

name: SoundModule_Register
comment: Entry of LECMODULE insane_sound: the Smush sound track manager (SOUND insane)

name: SoundModule_Open
comment: Zero-terminated list of track buffer sizes follows the three fixed arguments

name: SoundModule_PlayChunk
comment: Dispatches a sound chunk by its four-character tag: Crea(tive VOC), PSAD / SAUD (Smush audio)

name: SoundModule_MixCallback
comment: Mixes all active tracks into the driver buffer (called by DSound_FillStreamBuffer through the driver)
Size in bytes of the mixer accumulator g_pMixAccum
1 = mono mix, 2 = stereo (Mixer_ConvertTo16 converts twice the frame count)
Table of g_nMixTableUnits*0x8000 shorts built by Mixer_InitTables
Size parameter of the compander table (Mixer_Init)
IDirectSound used by the Smush stream driver
IDirectSoundBuffer: its primary buffer
IDirectSoundBuffer: looping stream buffer of g_nStreamBlocks blocks of 0x1800 bytes
Blocks in the DirectSound stream buffer (3..16)
Index of the block DSound_FillStreamBuffer wrote last (-1 = none)
Sample rate requested from DsndDriver_Open (at least 22050)
Volume 0..127 last passed to DsndDriver_SetVolume
Primary buffer volume saved by DsndDriver_InitDirectSound and restored on release
Mixer callback (count, Mixer_MixVoiceByFormat) given to DsndDriver_Open
Timer id of the periodic DSound_FillStreamBuffer call
Service table of the module manager handed to DsndDriver_Register
Interface of the TIMER clock module used by the DirectSound sound driver
Service table of the module manager handed to InsaneTimer_Register
Timer clock in ticks (InsaneTimer_Tick adds g_nTimerStep)
Ticks per InsaneTimer_Tick (0x4dae = 20.0 ms in the 1193180 Hz unit)
Kind (container version) of the sound each voice of the sound module receives
Stream key of the sound each voice of the sound module receives
Chunks already received of the streamed sound of each voice

name: Blocky16_Register
comment: Entry of LECMODULE insane_blocky16_flobdec: stores the module manager services and the workspace size, registers the module and the FLOBDEC interface

name: Blocky16_Unregister
comment: Unregisters the FLOBDEC interface and the module of the Blocky16 decoder

name: Blocky16_Init
comment: Asks the module manager for the BITMAP clear service and the MEMORY workspace service of the decoder; -1 if one is missing

name: Blocky16_Shutdown
comment: Frees the frame buffers and releases the two services of the Blocky16 decoder

name: Blocky16_GetInfoString
comment: Returns the name, description or help text of the Blocky16 module for index 0, 1 or 2

name: Blocky16_GetFourCC
comment: Returns the codec id Bl16 of the decoder

name: Blocky16_Prepare
comment: Reallocates the three frame buffers when the frame size or depth of the header differs from the current ones

name: Blocky16_AllocBuffers
comment: Allocates the three frame buffers (current, previous, before) for a frame size and clears them; sets up the display expand table memory

name: Blocky16_FreeBuffers
comment: Frees the three frame buffers and the expand table of the Blocky16 decoder

name: Blocky16_DecodeFrameEntry
comment: Interface entry of the decoder: drops the seventh argument and calls Blocky16_DecodeFrame

name: Blocky16_GetFrameInfo
comment: Reads four 16 bit fields of a frame header of the right size (0x100), returns -1 for any other size

name: Blocky16_BuildPixelOffsets
comment: Makes the pixel offsets of the split masks and the motion vectors for a frame width, once per width

name: Blocky16_BuildExpandTable
comment: Makes the 64K entry table that converts 16 bit pixels to the display format when the display channel shifts change

name: Blocky16_DecodeHalfRows16
comment: Decodes a method 1 frame: 16 bit pixels of every second row, the rows between are averaged

name: Blocky16_DecodeHalfRows8
comment: Decodes a method 7 frame: 8 bit indexes of every second row through a colour table, the rows between are averaged

name: Video_BlitConvert
comment: Copies or converts a clipped rectangle from one bitmap to another through VideoBitmap_ConvertPixels

name: Video_FillPixels
comment: Fills a number of pixels of 1 to 4 bytes with one pixel value

name: Rle_Begin
comment: Starts reading a run-length coded byte stream

name: Rle_NextByte
comment: Returns the next byte of a run-length coded stream; control byte bit 0 selects a run or literal bytes

name: Rle_Decode
comment: Decodes a number of bytes of a run-length coded stream into a buffer

name: Blocky16_SetOption
comment: Reads key and value pairs ending with key 0; key 1 sets the output callback g_pfnBlkOutput that Blocky16 hands decoded frames to; other keys are an error

name: Blocky16_BuildSplitMasks
comment: Builds the 8x8 or 4x4 split masks of the Blocky16 codec in g_aBlockySplit8 or g_aBlockySplit4 from the edge points g_anBlockySplit8X, g_anBlockySplit8Y, g_anBlockySplit4X and g_anBlockySplit4Y

name: Blocky16_DecodeFrame
comment: Decodes one Blocky16 frame into the buffers g_pbBlkCur, g_pbBlkPrev and g_pbBlkPrev2 using g_stBlockyDecState, g_asBlockyMotion, g_aBlockySplit4 and g_aBlockySplit8 and gives it to the output g_pfnBlkOutput; bitmaps g_pBlkBitmap0, g_pBlkBitmap1, g_pBlkBitmap2; tables g_pbBlkExpand, g_nBlkShiftR, g_nBlkShiftG, g_nBlkShiftB, g_pbBlkOutput, g_nBlkLastSeq

name: Blocky16_DecodeBlocks
comment: Decodes all 8x8 blocks of a method 2 frame into the current buffer (state in g_stBlockyDecState)

name: Blocky16_DecodeBlock8
comment: Decodes one 8x8 block (register convention in the original: ESI stream, EDI destination, EBP pitch)

name: Blocky16_DecodeBlock4
comment: Decodes one 4x4 block (register convention in the original: ESI stream, EDI destination, EBP pitch)

name: Blocky16_DecodeBlock2
comment: Decodes one 2x2 block (register convention in the original: ESI stream, EDI destination, EBP pitch)
Callback that receives the decoded Blocky16 frame instead of the default blit
Buffer the current Blocky16 frame is decoded into
64K entry table converting 16 bit pixels to the display format
Red channel shift of the display format the expand table was made for
Green channel shift of the display format the expand table was made for
Blue channel shift of the display format the expand table was made for
Bits per pixel of the Blocky16 frame buffers
Pixel format descriptor of the current frame buffer
Pixel format descriptor of the previous frame buffer
Pixel format descriptor of the frame buffer before the previous one
Number of pixels of a Blocky16 frame buffer
Buffer the last decoded Blocky16 frame was left in

Blocky16 frame buffer holding the previous frame
Number of the last Blocky16 frame decoded, -1 at the start
State of the Blocky16 block decoders: tables and offsets set by Blocky16_DecodeBlocks
Table of 256 split masks for 8x8 blocks, 0x184 bytes each, built by Blocky16_BuildSplitMasks
Table of 256 split masks for 4x4 blocks, 0x80 bytes each, built by Blocky16_BuildSplitMasks
Table of 255 motion vectors of the Blocky16 codec in pixels, made for the frame width
Column coordinates of the 16 edge points of a 4x4 block
Row coordinates of the 16 edge points of a 4x4 block

Row coordinates of the 16 edge points of an 8x8 block
